cosmology.opposing_view_detail: Lawful sea and sun gods are mocked as harbor masters who confuse taxes, charts, and chains for civilization.

pantheon.domains_summary: Mael Vark commands tempests, wrecks, and the brutal freedom of deep water.

epithets: He Who Smiles at Loaded Dice
pantheon.domains_summary: The Coin-Eater governs speculation, smuggling, midnight bargains, and profits won from peril.

pantheon.holy_symbol: black veil pinned with a knife
pantheon.domains_summary: She rules seduction, disguises, nighttime harbors, and every lie told with style.

pantheon.holy_symbol: closed eye in a droplet shield
pantheon.domains_summary: Oth keeps drowned souls, guards ships against the worst depths, and sanctifies sea graves.
Red Keel blesses boarding actions, long voyages, mutiny against tyrants, and ships that return aflame with victory.

flavor_text.one_line: A hard-bitten sea religion that blesses daring profits, brutal storms, and deaths paid back to the depths.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Black Wake Brotherhood treats the sea as the truest measure of freedom because no decree can stop a storm or command a current. Its priests tithe cargo by lot, bless piracy against overreaching powers, and maintain a grim peace between captains through shared ritual and fear of divine wreckage. To die unburied in the deep is not tragedy but settlement of a debt.
flavor_text.creation_myth_summary: Before land hardened, Mael Vark rolled over the world and shook loose the first islands like broken teeth.
flavor_text.moral_code_summary: Honor salvage shares, never deny the sea its due, strike first at any tyrant fleet, and accept risk as the only honest price of freedom.
